date_note: Daily Security's article of 27 November reports the announcement that day; it gives no earlier day.
title: Korea's PIPC activates emergency response system as breach reports reach 1,019 in ten months
summary: Daily Security reports that South Korea's PIPC activated an emergency response and inspection support system as AI-assisted hacking spreads, citing 1,019 breach reports from January to October 2026. From December it will run three months of emergency inspections of public agencies and companies, working with the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Financial Services Commission and the National Intelligence Service.
plain: Korea's data protection commission has started an emergency response system because of AI-assisted hacking. Daily Security reports 1,019 breach reports from January to October 2026.
exec: Korea's PIPC will run three months of emergency inspections of public agencies and companies from December, per Daily Security.

evidence.quote: 개인정보 유출 10개월간 1,019건…AI 해킹 확산에 개인정보위 긴급대응 체계 가동

validation.note: Only Daily Security was read; the PIPC's own announcement was not found.
